label: They are casing Six Flags, mega churches and the Vatican
description: Reconnaissance seen at Six Flags Over Texas in the Arlington area, at mega churches and at the Vatican, with Salt Lake City named alongside. He corrects himself on air from Warner Brothers to Six Flags. Given 20 December 2025.

label: A woman who lost her influence since Obama, but not all of it
description: A woman rated two out of ten now against ten when she was with Obama, said to be in the background but not finished, seen alongside a man in a black trench coat walking in Europe. Given 20 December 2025.

label: A great earthquake in Japan that splits the land
description: Japan seen shaking repeatedly, with a great earthquake said to split the land. Given 15 and 20 December 2025.

label: Revival in Venezuela on the heels of the overthrow
description: A religious revival among the Venezuelan people following the overthrow of the regime and the drug lords, with the slate cleaned. Given 18 December 2025.

label: Russia is working to a fifty year plan for the old empire
description: Russia described as playing beyond any one American administration, working to a fifty year plan to recover the whole of the old empire. Given 18 December 2025.

label: Out with the old: headlines saying prophetic voices are not needed
description: The world saying out with the old and in with the new, that prophetic voices are not needed, seen in New York Times and Washington Post headlines. Given 17 December 2025.
